$schemaNote: Ordered processing-stage inventory for pinned ntsc-rs add90f5bf1bf7e3c573e4e945a16f44a82941b51. Pipeline order from apply_effect_to_yiq_field (ntsc.rs:1150-1474). All former needsSourceRead items resolved with exact formulas except RNG-external items listed in remainingUnknowns.

constants.noiseSeeds: VIDEO_COMPOSITE=0 VIDEO_CHROMA_I=1 HEAD_SWITCHING=2 TRACKING_NOISE=3 VIDEO_CHROMA_PHASE=4 EDGE_WAVE=5 SNOW=6 CHROMA_LOSS=7 MID_LINE_JITTER=8 VIDEO_CHROMA_Q=9 VIDEO_LUMA=10 (ntsc.rs:591-604)
constants.phasefn: chroma_phase_shift(shift,offset,frame,line): 90/270 -> (frame+offset+(line>>1))&3; 180 -> (((frame+line)&2)+offset)&3; 0 -> 0 (ntsc.rs:276-289); called with line=row*2 (ntsc.rs:320,501,...); offset wraps mod 4 incl negatives

entryPoints.fieldDispatch: apply_effect_to_all_fields (ntsc.rs:1476-1517): Upper/Lower/Both single pass; InterleavedUpper: split at Upper.num_actual rows, upper half frame*2, lower half frame*2+1; InterleavedLower: split at Lower.num_actual rows, lower frame*2, upper frame*2+1; subview.field forced to Upper/Lower
entryPoints.rgbBlit: see fielding section; capi uses Bob (ntscrs-capi lib.rs:253-264)

fielding.blitIn: Upper src=r*2, Lower r*2+1, Both r (+rect.top; flip_y mirrors about other_buffer_height; rect height 1 forces row 0) (yiq_fielding.rs:604-632); Interleaved packs upper-field rows then lower-field rows (order per variant) (635-684)
fielding.blitOutBob: Upper/Lower: skipped-parity interior rows = mean of stored neighbors in YIQ then convert; row 0/H-1 and stored rows copied via (dst>>1).min(num_rows-1) (767-842); Skip leaves rows untouched (843-872); Interleaved: idx=((dst>>1)+row_offset).min(H-1), row_offset=Upper/Lower.num_image_rows(H)*(parity selector) (873-915); Both direct (916-941)
fielding.buffer: w*num_image_rows(H)*4 f32 = Y,I,Q,scratch contiguous (997-1023); scratch reused by demod copy, tracking shift_noise, edge_wave noise_dest, vert_blend delay
fielding.normalize: u8: in v/255, out (v*255).clamp(0,255) truncated to int (242-271); f32 passthrough; alpha always written ONE/opaque on output
fielding.numRows: Upper ceil(H/2), Lower max(floor(H/2),1), else H (73-82); num_actual_image_rows: Lower floor (can be 0) (87-96)
fielding.split: split_at_row cuts Y,I,Q AND scratch at idx*w; empty half -> None (453-484)

filterSemantics: UNCHANGED from v1 (verified ntsc.rs:20-89, filter.rs:57-179): constant-K alpha, triple cascade = 3rd order, Butterworth/notch biquads, with_scale shelf mix, Direct-Form-II-transposed, scipy lfilter_zi init, per-row causal, delay shifts output left.

rng.consumption_composite: video_noise_line (ntsc.rs:607-630): rng=Xoshiro(seed_from_u64(S.mix(row_u64).u64)); noise_seed=rng.next_u32() as i32; offset=rng.random::<f32>()*width; FBM{gain:1.0,lacun:2.0,freq:setting/hscale,oct:detail}; add_noise_1d(intensity*0.25,[offset],[w])
rng.consumption_other: phase_noise per-row offset=(S(row).f32-0.5)*2*intensity, S=Seeder(seed,4,frame) (ntsc.rs:702-715); snow/tracking rows: Xoshiro(seed_from_u64(S(row).u64)) into row_speckles (937-943,953-963); chroma_loss single Xoshiro(seed_from_u64(S(seed,7,frame).u64)) + Geometric gaps (1088-1115); headswitch per-row f32 (741-749), jitter avg of S(0),S(1) with seed 8 (763-770); tracking noise_seed=S.mix(0).i32, offset=S.mix(1).f32*num_rows, then seeder.mix(2) (887-892); edge_wave noise_seed=S.mix(0).i32, offset=S.mix(1).f32*H, S=Seeder(seed,5) NO frame mix (1058-1060)
rng.fromSeeder: u64 identity; i32 low 32 bits; f32 from_bits(((h&0xFFFFFFFF)>>9)|0x3F800000)-1.0; f64 from_bits((h|0x3FF0..)&0x3FFF..)-1.0 (random.rs:29-59)
rng.geometric: Geometric::new(p): lambda=ln(1-p), panics p<=0||p>1; sample=floor(ln(U)/lambda), U=random f64 (random.rs:5-27)
rng.seeder: SipHasher keys(0,0); chain Seeder::new(seed_u64).mix(pass_u64).mix(frame_usize).mix(row) (random.rs:61-83); finish = SipHash-2-4 with final block ((len&0xff)<<56)|tail (verified siphasher-1.0.3 src/sip.rs:321-332); byte stream = LE bytes per value (8B u64/usize on 64-bit, 4B i32)
rng.standardFloat: random::<f32>=(next_u32>>8)*2^-24; random::<f64>=(next_u64>>11)*2^-53; identical in rand 0.8.6 and 0.10.1 local sources; upstream rand 0.9 presumed same (verify if bit-exact)
rng.uniformRange: random_range(a..[=]b) f32 = v01*(b-a)+a, v01=from_bits((next_u32>>9)|0x3F800000)-1.0 (rand 0.10 sample_single path); rand 0.8 used scale=(b-a)/max_rand for inclusive -- upstream rand 0.9.0 source unavailable offline, see remainingUnknowns
rng.xoshiro: Xoshiro256PlusPlus::seed_from_u64 = SplitMix64 expansion; next_u32 = next_u64>>32; rng.jump() = stock xoshiro jump; replicate from rand_xoshiro/Vigna reference (external spec, not in-tree)

simplexFbm.fbm: p*=freq; r=s0; amp=gain; octaves-1 times: p*=lacunarity, r+=amp*s, amp*=gain (noise.rs:24-41); octaves=detail.clamp(1,5); NOTE video-noise FBM uses gain=1.0 (equal-amplitude octaves), edge_wave gain=1/sqrt2
simplexFbm.simplex1d: floor grid; ESGTSA hash of (i^seed): v=(v^2747636419)*2654435769, v=(v^(v>>16))*2654435769 x2 (hash.rs:7-17); gradient = +/-1..8 from top 4 bits, sign bit3 (simplex.rs:41-48); n=t0^4*g0*x0+t1^4*g1*x1, t=1-x^2 (12-37)
simplexFbm.simplex2d: skew F2=(sqrt3-1)/2, unskew G2=(1-1/sqrt3)/2 (grid.rs:36-84, note code negates a negative); PCG3D(i,j,seed) take [0] (hash.rs:20-39, simplex.rs:55-58); grad (|gx|,|gy|)=(1,2) if h<4 else (2,1), signs from h bits (86-106); t=max(0,.5-x^2-y^2); n=sum t^4*(g.d) (60-83)

stages.notes: Box: queue init [16/255,16/255,y0,y1]; i in 0..w-2: out[i]=mean(q), push y[i+2]; tail 2 px push last-sample. Notch: notch(0.5,2.0) FirstSample delay0.
Full: I 1.3MHz d2, Q 0.6MHz d4, Zero. Lite: both 2.6MHz d1. rate=NTSC_RATE*hscale.
y+=i*I_MULT[(x+xi)&3]+q*Q_MULT[(x+xi)&3]; I/Q NOT zeroed (302-303).
Always SINGLE constant-k (not filter_type): cutoff=(315MHz/88/2)*hscale, with_scale(-s), Zero, d0.
Per-row video_noise_line, seeder (seed,0,frame); freq=setting/hscale. See rng.consumption_composite.

Y ONLY. Per row: f=exp((U-int)/(int*(1-int)*(1-aniso))); line=aniso/(1+f)+int*(1-aniso); line*=0.125 clamp 0..1; skip if <=0. Geometric(line) gaps from x=-64; per hit: len=U[8,64]*hscale, frq=U[len*3,len*5]; rng.jump()+clone; row[i]+=cos(x*pi/frq)*(1-x/len)^2*U[-1,2); min advance +1/iter. EDGE: aniso=1&U==int -> 0/0=NaN (measure-zero; replicate IEEE or guard).

Y ONLY. rows/offset*=vscale round; return if offset>rows. affected=rows-offset; band = bottom affected rows of Y. top-of-band row index=aff, bottom=1: shift=setting*((idx+offset)/rows)^1.5 (STRONGEST at band top); noisy=(shift+U-0.5)*hscale, U=S(idx). mid_line only on top-of-band row (idx==aff): shift_row_to Const(0) into scratch, copy_start=(w*(pos+jitter))as usize (wraps if negative -> >w guard returns), copy back + transient (1-x/len)^3*tint, len=16*hscale, tint=(S(0)+0.5)*0.5. Others: in-place shift_row Const(0).

Y ONLY. rows*=vscale; band = bottom rows. shift_noise[0..min(rows,H)] = Simplex1d{seed=S.mix(0).i32,freq:0.5} from offset=S.mix(1).f32*num_rows. Per row: s=idx/rows (0 top -> ~1 bottom); shift_row(snoise*s*wave*0.25*hscale, Const0); video_noise_line(freq .25/hscale, int s^2*noise*4, oct 1); row_speckles(Xoshiro(S.mix(idx)), snow*s^2, aniso).

scratch=copy of Y. Box: y[i]=mean(mod[i-1]or16/255, mod[i], mod[i+1]clamp, mod[i+2]clamp). Notch: Y=notch(0.5,2,Zero,d0) then demod. 1-comb: y=(top+cur)/2, top=line r-1 or line 1 if r==0. 2-comb: y=.5cur+.25prev+.25next, prev=line1 if r==0, next=line H-2 if last. Height1 -> combs fall back to Notch. demodulate_chroma_line scalar reference (400-442): c=y[x]-mod[x]; o=(x+xi)&3; i=c*I_INV[o], q=c*Q_INV[o]; +=0.5*neighbor terms where in-bounds (x=0 and tail always scalar; SIMD must match).
Single constant-k lowpass cutoff=exp2(-4*amount)*0.25, rate=hscale (NOT NTSC_RATE -- quirk), Zero, d0, Y.
notch(clamp(freq/hscale,0,1),power).with_scale(intensity), FirstSample, d1, Y.
1D-per-row FBM (same as stage 5 machinery), freq=setting/hscale. vertical_scale NOT used.
Same as stage 12 per plane.
Rotate (I,Q) by angle=intensity*2pi every pixel (676-690).
Per row rotate by ((S(row)-0.5)*2*intensity)*2pi, S=Seeder(seed,4,frame).mix(row_usize).

h*=hscale; v=round(v*vscale). v<0: content moves UP |v| (dst r <- src r+|v|), bottom |v| zeroed. v>0: moves DOWN, top v zeroed. h==0 -> plain copy else shift_row_to Const(0). v==0 -> in-place shift_row per row.
stages.spatial: H subpixel lerp + integer V shift

stages.notes: Seeder(seed,5) NO frame mix. FBM{oct=detail.clamp(1,5),gain=1/sqrt2,lacun 2,freq=setting/vscale} 2D: noise[r]=FBM(offset+r, frame*speed). Per plane Y,I,Q per row: shift_row(noise/0.022*intensity*0.5*hscale, Extend).
Y lowpass_for_type(luma_cut) Zero d0; I/Q lowpass_for_type(chroma_cut) Zero d=round(chroma_delay*hscale); then extra single constant-k Y with_scale(-1.6) Zero d0.
Single Xoshiro; Geometric(loss) row gaps from 0; hit rows: I,Q zeroed. loss=1.0 blanks ALL rows (no panic).
cutoff=luma_cut*(4.0 if ConstantK else 1.0)*freq; with_scale(-int*2*freq); Zero d0; Y ONLY (chroma sharpen commented out 1427-1457).
out=(delay+cur)*0.5, delay=pre-blend cur; delay init 0 -> FIRST ROW HALVED toward black. I and Q joined.
Identical to stage 2.
